ابتذلا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَذَلَا (ibtaḏalā) /ib.ta.ða.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اُبْتُذِلَا (ubtuḏilā) /ub.tu.ði.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اِبْتَذِلَا (ibtaḏilā) /ib.ta.ði.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
